output.contract_title: Vendor Procurement Agreement with Enterprise Partner 011 LLC

clauses.clause_text: Customer shall pay all undisputed invoice amounts within thirty (30) days of invoice date.
Vendor shall notify Customer in writing within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of any confirmed Data Breach.
Each party's maximum aggregate liability shall be strictly limited to the total fees paid under this Agreement in the preceding twelve (12) months.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon providing thirty (30) days prior written notice.
This Agreement renews on an annual basis unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 30 days prior.

extraction_notes: Document extracted once for downstream policy comparison

mandatory_requirements.description: Payment terms shall not exceed Net 45 days from receipt of undisputed invoice.

recommended_requirements.description: Late payment penalties should not exceed 1.5% per month.

ambiguities_in_policy: Definition of "receipt of undisputed invoice" – unclear when an invoice is considered undisputed.
Whether "Net 45 days" refers to calendar days or business days.
Interpretation of the 1.5% monthly cap – does it apply per month cumulatively or reset each month, and does it apply to partial payments.

deviations.supporting_evidence: Mapping status is 'unaddressed' with no linked policy requirement, indicating the contract lacks a data protection clause required by organizational policy.
deviations.recommended_remediation: Add a data protection clause that complies with the organization's data security, privacy, and handling standards.

deviations.recommended_remediation: Insert a liability clause defining limits of liability, indemnification obligations, and required insurance coverage per policy.

deviations.supporting_evidence: Mapping status is 'unaddressed' with no linked policy requirement, indicating the contract does not specify term length or termination rights.
deviations.recommended_remediation: Specify the contract term, renewal options, and termination provisions in line with organizational guidelines.

deviations.recommended_remediation: Add renewal terms, notice periods, and any automatic renewal conditions as required by policy.

risk_findings.ambiguity_description: The term "undisputed invoice amounts" is not defined. No payment timeline is provided for disputed invoices, creating uncertainty and potential cash‑flow exposure for the Vendor.
"Confirmed Data Breach" is not defined, and the trigger "becoming aware of" is subjective. This may allow the Vendor to delay notification by arguing lack of confirmation.

Limiting liability to fees paid in the preceding twelve months may be insufficient for high‑impact losses (e.g., data breach, regulatory penalties). The clause also creates uncertainty for contracts shorter than twelve months.
Termination for convenience with only 30‑day notice can cause abrupt service disruption. No transition or wind‑down obligations are specified.

The renewal provision lacks definition of the method and form of the required non‑renewal notice and does not limit the number of automatic renewals, potentially leading to unintended contract extensions.
